description: Moves one clip to a new timeline position and/or onto another track. Address it by position (at) or region name; the address must match exactly one clip. to_track takes a track id, or "new" to create a track for it; without to the clip keeps its position. Give at least one of to and to_track.

at.description: Current position of the clip (exclusive with region)

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

to_track.description: Target track id, or "new" to create a track

unit.description: Unit for positions (default bars; bars/beats are 1-based, seconds/clocks absolute)

name: move_clip
title: Move clip
